cache_responses.what courses do you teach?:
I teach a variety of hands-on STEM courses for ages 9–18:
- Python Programming (Beginner to Advanced)
- Python + Algebra Year-Long Course
- AI Coding & Chatbot Development
- Web Development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React)
- Arduino & Electronics
- Computer Fundamentals (OS, CLI, hardware basics)
- Robotics with Python
- VR App Development
I also build custom tech courses and curriculum for schools and organizations.
cache_responses.what is your education?: I hold a **B.Eng in Electrical Engineering** from Queen Mary University of London and a **Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering** from Loyola Marymount University in Los Angeles.
cache_responses.how many students have you taught?: I’ve taught more than **2,000+ students** across my online platforms with an average rating of **4.82/5 stars** from parents and learners.
cache_responses.do you have a udemy course?: Yes. I recently launched **'Python Fundamentals: Fun and Practical Projects for Beginners'** on Udemy. I am also creating new courses on AI, Robotics, and Web Development.
cache_responses.what are your technical skills?:
I specialize in building scalable QA automation frameworks, LLM evaluation, and Agentic AI testing workflows.

**Core Tech Skills:**
- **AI & LLM:** DeepEval, LLM-as-a-judge, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agentic Workflows
- **Languages:** TypeScript, Python, JavaScript, Java, SQL
- **Automation:** Playwright, Selenium WebDriver, Appium, Pytest, TestNG
- **DevOps & Cloud:** Jenkins, TeamCity, GitHub Actions, Docker, AWS
- **Web Dev:** HTML, CSS, JS
I design modern, scalable test frameworks, automated quality gates, and AI agent testing tools.
cache_responses.tell me about your background: I was born in Bangladesh and grew up across several countries because of my father's airline career. I've lived in London, Los Angeles, and now New York, where I work remotely as a Senior AI Test Automation Engineer while teaching STEM globally. My diverse path—from teaching math to developing automation frameworks—shapes the way I teach and build technology today.
cache_responses.what is your career journey?: After completing my studies in London and Los Angeles, I worked in various fields before entering tech in 2020. I quickly advanced from QA Engineer to Senior AI Test Automation Engineer, pioneering LLM evaluation with DeepEval, agentic workflows with MCP, and architecting Playwright frameworks cutting regression time by 50% at Digital.ai. Alongside my industry work, I built a thriving teaching career, designing project-based courses for young learners and creating real-world technical tools such as Chrome extensions, dashboards, and AI agents.
